unresolved: THE QUERY IS UNFILTERED BY CYCLE. `filerName: ""` asks the index for everything it holds, so rows carry election years across many cycles and each row states its own `electionYear`. Filtering to one cycle is the promotion step's decision, not a normalizer's — a normalizer that dropped rows would make the staged file smaller than what was acquired.

FILER-LEVEL TOTALS ONLY. The CFS holds contribution and expenditure DETAIL behind endpoints this project has not derived (route nh-cfs-transaction-detail, REQUIRES_NEW_ADAPTER), so these totals are what the filer reported and are not an itemized record of their money.

NO BALLOT JOIN IS PERFORMED HERE. Matching a filer to a candidacy needs name AND office AND year, plus the county and district guards `lib/funding/state-money.ts` states; that judgement belongs to the promotion step and not to a normalizer.
